text:
collection {collection}: removed. Changes name collections; data in {collection} would belong to nothing.
To stop using it, keep it in the schema. To rename it, add the collection under its new name.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a collection of the previous lock is missing from the next one.
